job.title: Vice President, Fund Accounting
job.description:
Strategic leadership meets technical expertise in this Vice President, Fund Accounting opportunity within the financial services industry. This position is designed for an experienced professional who can oversee complex private equity accounting operations, lead multiple teams, and strengthen financial reporting and client service delivery.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to influence operational strategies, develop accounting professionals, and lead initiatives that improve efficiency and support the continued growth of the fund administration function.

 

About the Role

As a senior member of the fund accounting leadership team, the Vice President will be responsible for overseeing private equity accounting operations, managing client relationships, and ensuring financial reporting and service standards are consistently maintained.This position combines strategic oversight with technical accounting leadership and operational management. The successful candidate will guide accounting managers and their teams, address complex financial matters, and collaborate with stakeholders to enhance processes, strengthen controls, and support broader business objectives.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Provide strategic oversight of private equity fund accounting operations, ensuring consistent service quality and effective financial management.
  • Lead accounting managers and their teams, establishing priorities, monitoring performance, and supporting professional development.
  • Direct workflow planning and resource allocation to meet reporting deadlines and client commitments.
  • Oversee the review of Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations, financial statements, trial balances, and investor allocation schedules.
  • Ensure accurate calculation and reporting of fund expenses, management fees, carried interest, and investor distributions.
  • Supervise financial reporting activities, including general ledger reviews, capital transactions, and investor reporting.
  • Interpret fund documentation and investment agreements to ensure appropriate accounting treatment and reporting practices.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable accounting standards, regulatory obligations, and internal controls.
  • Coordinate external audits, ensuring supporting documentation and financial information are prepared accurately and on schedule.
  • Act as a senior contact for clients, providing technical accounting guidance and addressing complex service-related matters.
  • Partner with internal departments to coordinate tax reporting, investor services, and other operational requirements.
  • Oversee fund onboarding and transitions, ensuring accounting processes and client reporting requirements are properly established.
  • Support client relationship management, including service expectations, reporting commitments, and operational performance.
  • Lead recruitment, coaching, performance evaluations, and succession planning initiatives within the accounting function.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance financial processes, strengthen controls, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Drive technology enhancements, automation initiatives, and process improvement projects.
  • Monitor departmental performance, evaluate operational risks, and contribute to strategic planning and business initiatives.

What You Bring

  • University degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline; a professional designation such as CPA, CFA, or an equivalent qualification is considered an asset.
  • At least 8 years of progressive experience in private equity fund accounting, investment administration, or a related financial services environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in a senior leadership position overseeing accounting teams and managers.
  • Strong technical knowledge of private equity fund structures, investment accounting, and financial reporting requirements.
  • Extensive experience reviewing NAV calculations, financial statements, general ledger activities, and investor allocations.
  • Advanced understanding of distribution waterfalls, carried interest calculations, fund expenses, and related financial modelling.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and other relevant accounting frameworks.
  • Experience overseeing financial reporting, external audits, compliance requirements, and operational controls.
  • Proven ability to lead process improvements, technology implementations, or operational transformation initiatives.
  • Strong commercial awareness, financial analysis, business planning, and resource management capabilities.
  • Experience managing client relationships, resolving complex accounting matters, and maintaining service standards.
  • Familiarity with fund administration platforms, financial management systems, and reporting tools.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong proficiency with financial reporting applications.
  • Excellent leadership and people development skills, including mentoring, coaching, and performance management.
  • Strong project management and organizational abilities, with the capacity to oversee multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Effective communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical, adaptable, and capable of making informed decisions in a complex financial environment.

Why Join

This opportunity offers the chance to take on a senior leadership position within a financial services environment focused on complex private equity fund administration. You'll have the ability to influence operational direction, lead and develop experienced accounting teams, and contribute to improvements in financial reporting, client service, and technology-driven processes. With exposure to strategic initiatives and opportunities to collaborate with senior professionals across different business functions, this role provides a platform to expand your leadership impact and contribute to the continued development of the organization.

job.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
job.description:
Accurate invoice processing and efficient payment workflows are essential to a well-functioning finance team. An opportunity is available for an experienced Accounts Payable Specialist to support daily accounting activities while contributing to process improvements and financial systems initiatives.

This role is ideal for someone who brings strong purchase order processing experience, enjoys resolving accounting discrepancies, and can confidently work with stakeholders across different levels of an organization.

 

 

About the Role

Working closely with the accounting team, the Accounts Payable Specialist will manage invoice processing, purchase order reconciliation, and payment approvals while maintaining accurate financial records.

job.title: Financial Reporting Analyst
job.description:
Bringing financial data and business performance together, this Financial Reporting Analyst opportunity offers a combination of financial reporting, portfolio analysis, and strategic financial planning. This position is ideal for an analytical finance professional who enjoys developing financial models, evaluating investment performance, and translating complex financial information into meaningful business insights.The successful candidate will work closely with accounting, finance, and operational teams to support financial reporting, improve forecasting processes, and contribute to key business and investment decisions.

 

 

About the Role

Reporting to senior finance leadership, the Financial Reporting Analyst will support financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis across a portfolio of assets and business operations.The role combines traditional accounting and financial analysis with exposure to investment evaluation, financial modelling, and cross-functional projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial information, identifying performance trends, and developing reporting tools that support operational and strategic decision-making.

 

 

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare and analyze financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, cash flow summaries, and management reporting packages.
  • Perform detailed variance analysis against budgets, forecasts, and historical results, providing insights into financial performance.
  • Evaluate revenue, operating expenses, and other financial drivers to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain financial models to support budgeting, forecasting, investment analysis, and business planning.
  • Monitor portfolio performance using financial and operational metrics, including occupancy, leasing activity, operating income, and capital expenditures.
  • Support annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, and financial planning activities across multiple properties and business units.
  • Prepare cash flow projections, scenario analyses, and financial assessments to support management decisions.
  • Collaborate with accounting teams to reconcile financial models, general ledger information, and reported financial results.
  • Review financial statements and supporting schedules to ensure accuracy, consistency, and appropriate accounting treatment.
  • Assist with financial activities related to property investments, development projects, financing arrangements, and capital expenditures.
  • Support lender reporting, financial compliance requirements, and the preparation of documentation for audits and tax reporting.
  • Participate in financial evaluations and due diligence activities for potential investments and development opportunities.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to assess project costs, financial assumptions, and changes affecting investment performance.
  • Develop reporting templates, financial dashboards, and analytical tools to improve the efficiency and consistency of financial information.
  • Support financial systems enhancements, data integration, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Prepare ad hoc financial analyses, presentations, and recommendations for senior management.

 

 

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 2–4 years of experience in financial reporting, financial analysis, accounting, or a related finance function.
  • Experience in real estate investment, property management, asset management, or a similar environment is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, full-cycle accounting processes, and general ledger activities.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modelling, forecasting, and data analysis.
  • Experience preparing budgets, financial projections, variance analyses, and management reports.
  • Familiarity with real estate financial concepts, including Net Operating Income (NOI), capitalization rates, Internal Rate of Return (IRR), and investment cash flow analysis.
  • Experience analyzing portfolio performance, property-level financial results, or capital investment activities is an asset.
  • Knowledge of financial modelling techniques, sensitivity analysis, and scenario planning.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and familiarity with financial reporting or data visualization tools.
  • Experience working with accounting software, ERP systems, or financial management platforms is preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret financial information and communicate findings clearly.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate financial records.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments and competing deadlines.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across finance, accounting, and operational teams.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment with evolving business priorities.

 

 

Why Join

This opportunity offers the chance to develop a well-rounded finance career by combining financial reporting, investment analysis, and strategic business support. The role provides exposure to portfolio performance, financial modelling, and investment-related projects while working closely with experienced finance professionals and cross-functional teams. With opportunities to contribute to financial planning, reporting improvements, and broader business initiatives, this position is well-suited to someone looking to strengthen their technical expertise, expand their analytical capabilities, and play an active role in supporting business growth.

job.title: U.S. Tax Manager

job.title: Controller

job.description:
An established organization is seeking a Financial Analyst, FP&A to join its finance team. This role is well suited to an analytical finance professional who enjoys working with complex financial information, building meaningful reports, and partnering with stakeholders across the business.

Working closely with FP&A leadership, the Financial Analyst will support financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, and performance analysis. The role will bring together financial and operational information from multiple areas of the organization and help turn that data into clear insights for management. This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who enjoys improving reporting processes, working with large datasets, and developing a deeper understanding of business performance.

What You’ll Do

  • Coordinate recurring financial reporting and consolidate information from multiple business units and operational teams.
  • Collect, review, and validate financial and operational data to ensure reporting is complete and accurate.
  • Maintain financial models, reporting templates, and supporting schedules used across the organization.
  • Perform detailed variance analysis comparing actual results against budgets, forecasts, and previous periods.
  • Investigate significant financial variances and work with business stakeholders to understand underlying drivers.
  • Support the annual budgeting process and take ownership of assigned planning and reporting activities.
  • Assist with periodic forecasting and update financial models as business and operational assumptions change.
  • Prepare analysis related to operating expenses, capital expenditures, cash flow, liquidity, and overall financial performance.
  • Support cash flow forecasting and working capital analysis.
  • Develop financial models and analyses to support operational initiatives and management decision-making.
  • Identify financial trends, potential risks, and opportunities through detailed data analysis.
  • Partner with finance and operational stakeholders to gather information and support their reporting and analysis needs.
  • Respond to ad hoc financial requests and provide analysis to support management decisions.
  • Contribute to improvements in financial systems, reporting processes, and cost-monitoring capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting activities and reduce manual processes.
  • Provide backup support for key FP&A reporting responsibilities when required.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 3–5 years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, financial reporting, or a related area.
  • CPA designation or progress toward a CPA is considered an asset but is not required.
  • Previous experience within the mining, natural resources, industrial, or another operationally complex environment is considered an asset.
  • Strong experience with budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and management reporting.
  • Demonstrated financial modelling skills and the ability to work confidently with large and complex datasets.
  • Advanced spreadsheet skills, including experience with data manipulation, lookup functions, pivot reporting, and analytical tools.
  • Experience working with enterprise financial systems or ERP platforms.
  • Exposure to business intelligence, visualization, or financial reporting tools is considered an asset.
  • Strong presentation skills with the ability to communicate financial information clearly to different audiences.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines while collaborating effectively across departments.

Why Join

This opportunity provides broad exposure to the FP&A function, including financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, modelling, cash flow analysis, and business partnering.

You’ll work with financial and operational stakeholders across different areas of the organization, giving you the opportunity to understand how business activities translate into financial performance and management decisions.

The role also provides meaningful exposure to process improvement, reporting automation, and financial systems initiatives, making it a strong opportunity for an analyst looking to expand their technical capabilities and take on greater ownership within FP&A.

job.title: Accounting Intermediate Supervisor
job.description:
An established Canadian organization is seeking an Accounting IntermediateSupervisor to join its finance team. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced accounting professional who is ready to take the next step into a broader leadership role.

The successful candidate will oversee key day-to-day accounting activities while providing guidance and support to members of the accounting team. The role offers broad exposure across financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, payroll oversight, internal controls, audit support, and financial analysis. A key component of this opportunity is career progression. The organization is looking for someone who has already demonstrated leadership potential and is ready to further develop their management capabilities. The successful candidate will receive hands-on training and increased responsibility, with the opportunity to progress into a more senior finance leadership position over approximately the next 12 months.

What You’ll Do

  • Oversee day-to-day accounting activities and ensure transactions are completed accurately and within required timelines.
  • Manage general ledger activities, account reconciliations, and the integrity of financial records.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial reporting and closing processes.
  • Review balance sheet and income statement accounts and investigate discrepancies or unusual activity.
  • Prepare financial reports, management analyses, forecasts, and other information used to support business decisions.
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual budgeting and ongoing forecasting activities.
  • Partner with operational leaders to review budgets, financial results, cost variances, and business performance.

  • Support indirect tax filings and other applicable financial and regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Assist with the development and continuous improvement of accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Support external audits by preparing documentation, responding to information requests, and coordinating with external advisors.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline accounting processes and improve the overall efficiency of the finance function.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to management to support short- and long-term planning.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Approximately 8+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience.
  • Previous experience supervising, mentoring, or providing day-to-day guidance to accounting professionals is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of general accounting principles, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and internal controls.
  • Hands-on experience with general ledger accounting and financial statement preparation and analysis.
  • Exposure to payroll, audit, tax compliance, and regulatory reporting processes.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial results, identify trends, and provide practical recommendations.
  • Experience working with accounting, payroll, financial reporting, or enterprise management systems.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • A proactive and solutions-oriented approach to identifying financial and operational issues.
  • Demonstrated leadership potential and a genuine interest in progressing into a broader management role.

Why Join

This role offers more than traditional accounting supervision. It is designed for an experienced accounting professional who is ready to transition into the next stage of their leadership career. You’ll gain hands-on exposure to a broad range of accounting and finance responsibilities while working closely with senior leadership and developing your ability to manage both people and financial processes. Most importantly, there is a clear path toward a more senior finance leadership position, with training, mentorship, and progressively greater responsibility expected over the first year. It’s an excellent opportunity for someone who has built a strong accounting foundation and is ready to take on greater ownership within a finance team.

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst
job.description:

job.title: Construction Accountant
job.description:

About the Role

This position plays a key role in managing the financial side of assigned projects, from budgeting and billing through forecasting and final closeout. Working closely with project managers and senior leadership, the Construction Accountant will provide accurate reporting, identify financial risks and opportunities, and help drive informed decisions throughout each project.

What You’ll Do

  • Maintain project budgets, purchase orders, contracts, change orders, and related financial documentation
  • Review invoices, expenses, and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy and alignment with project requirements
  • Work with vendors and subcontractors regarding billing, payments, documentation, and compliance requirements

  • Prepare monthly project billings and coordinate the distribution of required payment documentation
  • Manage accounts receivable activities and support timely collection of outstanding balances
  • Prepare project financial reports, profitability analysis, cash flow information, and ad-hoc reporting for leadership

  • Identify financial risks and opportunities and work with project teams to develop mitigation strategies
  • Ensure project records and financial documentation remain complete, accurate, and organized through project closeout
  • Support contract administration and help ensure financial activities comply with relevant agreements and organizational policies
  • Assist with year-end audits, quarterly reporting, working papers, and other financial requirements
  • Collaborate with legal, compliance, and operational teams when contractual or financial issues arise
  • Contribute to process improvements that increase financial accuracy, efficiency, and visibility

What You Bring

  • Degree or diploma in accounting, finance, or a related discipline
  • CPA designation or progress toward the designation is an asset

Why Join

job.title: Controller
job.description:

job.title: Project Accountant
job.description:
A project-driven organization in the natural resources and infrastructure sector is seeking a Project Accountant to join its finance team supporting a major development in Quebec. This is an exciting opportunity to work closely with operations, contribute to the financial success of a large-scale development, and help establish finance processes in a dynamic, evolving environment.

About the Role

Reporting to a senior member of the finance team, the Project Accountant will support the financial management of a major development project. This position focuses on project accounting rather than traditional corporate accounting and offers broad exposure to project costing, financial reporting, procurement support, and process development. As the project grows, the scope of the role will continue to evolve, providing excellent opportunities for professional growth and increased responsibility.

What You'll Do

  • Monitor project costs, budgets, and expenditures to support effective financial management
  • Prepare project financial reports, forecasts, and analysis for finance and operational leadership
  • Track commitments, cost allocations, and project spending throughout the project lifecycle
  • Support procurement-related accounting activities, including invoice processing, vendor reconciliations, and cost tracking
  • Partner with project managers and operational teams to provide financial insights and support decision-making
  • Assist with month-end close activities, reconciliations, and financial reporting related to the project
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting, controls, and financial processes as the project develops
  • Help establish scalable finance procedures and best practices within a growing project environment
  • Support special projects and other finance initiatives as business needs evolve
  • Travel to the project site in Quebec as required to collaborate with operational stakeholders

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in project accounting or project finance
  • Experience within the mining, construction, engineering, infrastructure, or other project-based industries
  • Strong understanding of project costing, budgeting, cost tracking, and financial reporting
  • Bilingual communication skills in both French and English
  • Experience using ERP systems and strong Microsoft Excel skills
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and adapt to a changing project environment
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills with both finance and operational teams
  • CPA designation is considered an asset but is not required
  • Ability to travel to project sites within Quebec as needed

Why Join

This is a unique opportunity to join a growing organization during an exciting stage of project development. You'll play a key role in building financial processes, working alongside operational teams, and contributing directly to the success of a major capital project. If you're looking for a broad, hands-on accounting role with meaningful impact, strong autonomy, and long-term growth potential, this position offers an excellent next step in your career.

 

Comptable de projet

Une organisation axée sur les projets dans le secteur des ressources naturelles et des infrastructures est à la recherche d'un Comptable de projet pour se joindre à son équipe des finances afin de soutenir un important projet de développement au Québec. Il s'agit d'une excellente occasion de travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles, de contribuer à la réussite financière d'un projet d'envergure et de participer à la mise en place des processus financiers dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution.

À propos du poste

Relevant d'un membre senior de l'équipe des finances, le Comptable de projet jouera un rôle clé dans la gestion financière d'un important projet de développement. Ce poste est principalement axé sur la comptabilité de projet plutôt que sur la comptabilité corporative traditionnelle. Vous serez impliqué dans le suivi des coûts de projet, la production de rapports financiers, le soutien aux activités d'approvisionnement ainsi que l'amélioration des processus financiers. À mesure que le projet évoluera, les responsabilités associées au poste se développeront également, offrant d'excellentes possibilités de croissance professionnelle.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Assurer le suivi des coûts, des budgets et des dépenses du projet afin de soutenir une gestion financière efficace.
  • Préparer les rapports financiers, les prévisions et les analyses destinés aux équipes des finances et des opérations.
  • Effectuer le suivi des engagements financiers, des répartitions de coûts et des dépenses tout au long du cycle de vie du projet.
  • Soutenir les activités comptables liées aux approvisionnements, notamment le traitement des factures, les rapprochements avec les fournisseurs et le suivi des coûts.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de projet et les équipes opérationnelles afin de fournir des analyses financières favorisant une prise de décision éclairée.
  • Participer aux activités de clôture de fin de mois, aux rapprochements de comptes et à la production des rapports financiers liés au projet.
  • Identifier des occasions d'améliorer les processus financiers, les contrôles internes et les outils de production de rapports à mesure que le projet progresse.
  • Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la documentation de procédures financières évolutives ainsi que des meilleures pratiques.
  • Participer à des projets spéciaux et à d'autres initiatives financières selon les besoins de l'organisation.
  • Se déplacer au site du projet au Québec, au besoin, afin de collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles.

Ce que vous apportez

  • Minimum de trois (3) années d'expérience en comptabilité de projet ou en finance de projet.
  • Expérience acquise dans les secteurs minier, de la construction, de l'ingénierie, des infrastructures ou dans tout autre environnement axé sur les projets.
  • Excellente compréhension du suivi des coûts de projet, de la budgétisation, de l'analyse des coûts et de la production de rapports financiers.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en français et en anglais.
  • Expérience avec un système ERP ainsi qu'une très bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Excel.
  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome, à gérer plusieurs priorités et à évoluer dans un environnement en constante évolution.
  • Excellentes habiletés en communication et en collaboration avec les équipes des finances et des opérations.
  • Le titre de CPA constitue un atout, mais n'est pas une exigence.
  • Disponibilité pour se déplacer sur le site du projet au Québec lorsque requis.

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous

Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de vous joindre à une organisation à une étape clé du développement d'un projet majeur. Vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans la mise en place des processus financiers, collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes opérationnelles et contribuerez directement au succès d'un important projet d'investissement. Si vous recherchez un poste diversifié, concret et offrant une grande autonomie, où vous pourrez avoir un impact réel tout en poursuivant votre développement professionnel, cette opportunité pourrait représenter la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

job.title: Project Accountant

job.title: Finance Manager

This is an opportunity for an experienced finance professional to take ownership of financial reporting, technical accounting, budgeting, and financial planning while working closely with the CFO and senior leadership to support business performance and strategic growth.
